method: Claim-level editorial review against current primary Australian government and regulator guidance. Source digests invalidate a review when an article changes.

amarone-della-valpolicella.note: Flag is a regulatory pregnancy-warning reference; no individual health advice.

bardolino.note: Flag is denomination and Australian label terminology; no individual health advice.

building-a-wine-tasting-flight.note: Pregnancy wording aligned to Australian Government guidance.

canned-wine-explained.note: Clarified NHMRC limits are risk-reduction, not no-risk limits; linked FSANZ.

cleanskin-wine-explained.note: Flag is Australian packaging regulation; no health recommendation.

how-to-buy-wine-for-immediate-drinking.note: Age, driving, pregnancy and alcohol-free wording made precise.

how-to-choose-dessert-wine.note: Pregnancy-label statement linked to FSANZ without oversimplified threshold language.

how-to-choose-wine-as-a-gift.note: Alcohol-free and labelling language clarified; FSANZ linked.

how-to-host-a-blind-wine-tasting.note: Replaced blanket medication advice with interaction warning and pharmacist/doctor direction.

how-to-read-a-wine-label.note: Pregnancy-label statement linked directly to FSANZ.

how-to-spot-misleading-wine-marketing.note: Health-claim discussion is consumer regulatory education, not a health-benefit claim.

how-to-taste-wine.note: NHMRC risk limits and Australian Government pregnancy advice stated separately and linked.

marsala-wine.note: Flag is a packaging-warning reference; no individual health advice.

no-alcohol-and-dealcoholised-wine.note: FSANZ thresholds linked and distinguished from proof of absolute zero alcohol.

vintage-port.note: Flag is packaging and responsible-consumption context; no personalised advice.

what-does-corked-wine-smell-like.note: Removed implied universal safety conclusion; separated sensory fault from possible contamination.

what-is-cork-taint.note: Removed implied medical conclusion and added conservative bottle-condition guidance.

what-is-sediment-in-wine.note: Removed categorical harmlessness claim; cannot identify unknown particles by sight.

what-unfiltered-wine-means.note: Article correctly states that unfiltered wording alone cannot determine safety.

when-to-drink-a-wine.note: Separated maturity from contamination; added conservative direction and NHMRC link.

wine-for-christmas-lunch.note: Clarified NHMRC risk limits, pregnancy, driving, medicines and alcohol-free choices.
